messages:
maria: Heads-up — since the maintenance window in ap-northeast1 we're seeing a steady trickle of tiny-pod evictions and a backlog of Pending tiny pods. big-gpu jobs are full, but overall GPU util is ~60%.

alex: saw the same. eviction_rate on the region spiked ~5x at 02:10 UTC. pending_gpus graph shows lots of small 0.25GPU requests accumulating. link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/cluster/ ap-northeast1

jin: can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` for one of the Pending ones? curious if it's failing scheduling or being preempted.

maria: quick dump:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n ml-apps tiny-encoder-7fb9 Pending 0/1  0s
Events:
  Normal   FailedScheduling  15s  default-scheduler  0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient gpu, 3 node(s) failed affinity.
```
seems like affinity + insufficient tiny-slot shape.

sophia: two theories: 1) the warm-pools heuristic bumped up packing density for large jobs during maintenance (better cost) and left tiny-slot islands; 2) taint `gpu.shape=large:NoSchedule` may be leaking on some racks so tiny pods can't fit.

tim: also seeing attach/detach latency from the block-storage logs around the same time — 80-120s for device attach during node reboots. That could cause transient slot invisibility and skew binpacking.

alex: interesting — if attach latency hides GPU capacity for ~2min, the scheduler might not see those nodes and pack elsewhere, then when nodes come back they appear full and tiny pods are stranded.

jin: sched logs show frequent lease heartbeat timeouts around 02:08-02:12. snippet:
```
I0302 02:09:12 scheduler.go:412] lease heartbeat timed out for node gpu-rack-12, resyncing allocations
I0302 02:09:23 scheduler.go:423] late bind backoff for tiny pod batch; requeue
```
that matches the window.

sophia: sched-bot rolled out `binpack-density:v2` around 02:05 per the deploy audit. sched-bot: can you confirm?

sched-bot: @sophia confirmed: rollout binpack-density:v2 to ap-northeast1 at 02:04 UTC. Canary passed metrics, but release notes warned of transient warm-pool tightening.

maria: ok that ties it together. rollout tightened packing, attach latency + lease timeouts created a short-term illusion of capacity -> large jobs got placed densely -> tiny pods got stranded in small islands.

tim: short-term mitigation: 1) relax tiny-pod soft-affinity (allow cross-rack), 2) bump warmpool min for tiny-slot class by +2 nodes, 3) increase attach timeout threshold so hidden nodes reappear quicker. Which one do we want now?

alex: do 2 and 3 immediately. bumping warmpool helps availability and keeps cost delta small for now.

jin: I'll open a quick PR to revert the packing parameter for ap-northeast1 to the previous value and add a canary that watches tiny-pod pending_rate.

sophia: action items:
- jin: revert binpack-density:v2 for ap-northeast1 canary (PR + rollback if not green)
- tim: patch attach timeout / node heartbeat thresholds in infra (hotfix)
- alex: provision +2 tiny-warmpool nodes in ap-northeast1 (reserved preemptible)
- maria: monitor pending_tiny_pods and eviction_rate, post update in this thread

maria: thanks everyone. will post metrics check in 15m. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — keeping an eye on cost impact estimate for +2 nodes, should be minimal.

sched-bot: incident-note created: "ap-northeast1 tiny-pod evictions after binpack-density:v2 rollout" assigned to eng-platform oncall.

maria: updating — pending_tiny_pods dropped ~70% after provisioning and timeout patch. still watching for any re-eviction.
